DB round-trip test (un-mocked).

90->landscape — not double-rotated). Passthrough re-encodes to oriented webp
when rotation!=0, else streams verbatim. Both /file routes forward photo.rotation;
route delegation tests updated + non-zero forwarding case.

rejected request (8 tests incl. member-without-canAddPhotos -> 403).

createPortal(document.body). 7 e2e pass across tablet/phone/desktop.
